title: teleporter rp
description: This resource pack will recolor items used in redstone teleportation mechanisms in the ender style.
body:
This resource pack will make the items that use vanilla redstone teleportation mechanisms stand out
 
This resource pack refers to the teleportation mechanisms on the fishing rod, on cats

# This pack changes the textures

-  Fishing rod
-  Ender pearls
-  Eye of ender
-  Cats
 
The **fishing rod** is inverted, because that's how endermen see it\
The **pearl and eye of ender** received a higher resolution texture to make these wonderful items stand out\
The **cats** are now half endermen, because they help us overcome spaces
